mapper.select: SELECT s.id, s.price, s.movie_id, s.hall_id, s.start_time, s.end_time, s.duration_minutes_snapshot, s.turnaround_minutes_snapshot, s.sale_start_time, s.sale_end_time, s.admission_open_time, s.status, s.version, s.create_time, s.update_time FROM screening s INNER JOIN movie m ON m.id = s.movie_id INNER JOIN hall h ON h.id = s.hall_id WHERE s.movie_id = #{movieId} AND m.status = 0 AND h.status = 0 AND s.status IN (0, 1) AND s.sale_end_time > DATE_ADD(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), INTERVAL 8 HOUR) ORDER BY s.start_time ASC, s.id ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE screening_id = #{id}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE screening_id = #{id} AND status IN (0, 1, 4)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screening_seat WHERE screening_id = #{id} AND (status IN (1, 2) OR order_id IS NOT NULL)

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screening_seat ss JOIN screening s ON s.id = ss.screening_id JOIN seat st ON st.id = ss.seat_id AND st.hall_id = s.hall_id AND st.status = 0 WHERE ss.screening_id = #{id} AND ss.status = 0 AND ss.order_id IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screening WHERE hall_id = #{hallId} AND status NOT IN (3, 4)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM screening_seat ss JOIN screening s ON s.id = ss.screening_id WHERE ss.seat_id = #{seatId} AND s.status NOT IN (3, 4)
mapper.update: UPDATE screening SET movie_id = #{value.movieId}, hall_id = #{value.hallId}, price = #{value.price}, start_time = #{value.startTime}, end_time = #{value.endTime}, duration_minutes_snapshot = #{value.durationMinutesSnapshot}, turnaround_minutes_snapshot = #{value.turnaroundMinutesSnapshot}, sale_start_time = #{value.saleStartTime}, sale_end_time = #{value.saleEndTime}, admission_open_time = #{value.admissionOpenTime}, version = version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{value.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 0 AND sale_start_time > #{now}
UPDATE screening SET version = version + 1, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status IN (0, 2) AND end_time > #{now}
UPDATE screening SET status = 3, update_time = UTC_TIMESTAMP() WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{version} AND status IN (0, 2) AND end_time > #{now}
